mapper.sql: select id, order_sub_id, product_id, specification_id, price, number, label_id, label_name, remark, status, supplier_id, supplier_price, occupy_store_number, occupy_transit_number, occupy_transit_purchase_item_id, occupy_transit_enter_number, enter_number, delivery_number, end_return_number, apply_purchase_number, confirm_item_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted,base_price from sal_yt_order_sub_item where is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select syosi.*,pyp.code as productCode, (select hand_product_level from pro_yt_product_specification where id = syosi.specification_id and is_deleted=0 ) as hand_product_level from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = syosi.product_id where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and order_sub_id = #{orderSubId}

and order_sub_id in
#{orderSubId}
mapper.delete: update sal_yt_order_sub_item set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id}

update sal_yt_order_sub_item set is_deleted = 1 where id in
#{id}
update sal_yt_order_sub_item set is_deleted = 1 where order_sub_id = #{orderSubId}
mapper.select: select syosi.* from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.confirm_item_id = #{confirmItemId}

select syosi.* from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi inner join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id and syos.is_deleted = 0 inner join sal_yt_order as syo on syo.id = syos.order_id and syo.is_deleted = 0 where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} and (syosi.occupy_transit_number - COALESCE(syosi.occupy_transit_enter_number, 0)) > 0 and (syosi.number - COALESCE(syosi.enter_number, 0)) > 0 order by syo.delivery_time,syo.order_time,syo.create_time

select syosi.* from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id left join sal_yt_order as syo on syos.order_id = syo.id where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syos.is_deleted = 0 and syo.is_deleted = 0 and syo.customer_id = #{customerId} and syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} and ( syosi.number > syosi.enter_number )

select syosi.*, COALESCE(current_bind.currentBindNumber, 0) as currentBindNumber, COALESCE(total_bind.totalBindNumber, 0) as totalBindNumber, (syosi.occupy_transit_number - COALESCE(syosi.occupy_transit_enter_number, 0)) as occupyTransitNumber, syos.sub_code as order_sub_code, syc.name as customer_name, syo.code as orderCode, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.sale_employee_id) as salesEmployeeName, syo.delivery_time as deliveryTime from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join ( select pypi.order_sub_item_id as order_sub_item_id, sum(greatest(least(coalesce(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) - syso.enter_number, 0)) as currentBindNumber from sto_yt_store_order as syso inner join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on pypi.id = syso.purchase_item_id and pypi.is_deleted = 0 left join pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap on pap.id = pypi.apply_purchase_id where syso.is_deleted = 0
and syso.id in
#{storeOrderId}
and 1 = 0
group by pypi.order_sub_item_id ) as current_bind on current_bind.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id left join ( select pypi.order_sub_item_id as order_sub_item_id, sum(greatest(least(coalesce(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) - syso.enter_number, 0)) as totalBindNumber from sto_yt_store_order as syso inner join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on pypi.id = syso.purchase_item_id and pypi.is_deleted = 0 left join pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap on pap.id = pypi.apply_purchase_id where syso.is_deleted = 0 group by pypi.order_sub_item_id ) as total_bind on total_bind.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syos.is_deleted = 0 left join sal_yt_order as syo on syos.order_id = syo.id and syo.is_deleted = 0 left join sal_yt_customer as syc on syo.customer_id = syc.id and syc.is_deleted = 0 where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} and syosi.number > 0 and syosi.status < 4 and syosi.status >= 1
and syc.name like concat('%',#{customerName},'%')

select syosi.*, COALESCE(current_bind.currentBindNumber, 0) as currentBindNumber, COALESCE(total_bind.totalBindNumber, 0) as totalBindNumber, (syosi.number - COALESCE(syosi.enter_number, 0)) as totalOccupyTransitNumber, syos.sub_code as order_sub_code, syo.code as orderCode, syc.name as customer_name, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syo.sale_employee_id) as salesEmployeeName, syo.delivery_time as deliveryTime from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join ( select pypi.order_sub_item_id as order_sub_item_id, sum(greatest(least(coalesce(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) - syso.enter_number, 0)) as currentBindNumber from sto_yt_store_order as syso inner join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on pypi.id = syso.purchase_item_id and pypi.is_deleted = 0 left join pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap on pap.id = pypi.apply_purchase_id where syso.is_deleted = 0
and syso.id in
#{storeOrderId}
and 1 = 0
group by pypi.order_sub_item_id ) as current_bind on current_bind.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id left join ( select pypi.order_sub_item_id as order_sub_item_id, sum(greatest(least(coalesce(pap.number, pypi.number), syso.total_number) - syso.enter_number, 0)) as totalBindNumber from sto_yt_store_order as syso inner join pur_yt_purchase_item as pypi on pypi.id = syso.purchase_item_id and pypi.is_deleted = 0 left join pur_yt_apply_purchase as pap on pap.id = pypi.apply_purchase_id where syso.is_deleted = 0 group by pypi.order_sub_item_id ) as total_bind on total_bind.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syos.is_deleted = 0 left join sal_yt_order as syo on syos.order_id = syo.id and syo.is_deleted = 0 left join sal_yt_customer as syc on syo.customer_id = syc.id and syc.is_deleted = 0 where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syos.is_deleted=0 and syo.is_deleted=0 and syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} and syosi.status < 4 and syosi.status >= 0 and (syosi.number - COALESCE(syosi.enter_number, 0)) > 0
and syc.name like concat('%',#{customerName},'%')
and syosi.label_id =#{labelId}

select count(distinct syo.id) as orderCount, sum(syosi.number) as productCount from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join sal_yt_order_sub as syos on syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id and syos.is_deleted = 0 left join sal_yt_order as syo on syos.order_id = syo.id and syo.is_deleted = 0 where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} and syo.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.order_id) AS orderCount, SUM(t.item_num) AS itemCount, -- 汇总总金额：商品总价 + 符合条件的运费 - 优惠 SUM(t.goods_total_price + t.shipping_fee - t.discount_fee) AS orderTotalPrice FROM ( SELECT syos.order_id, SUM(syosi.number) AS item_num, SUM(syosi.number * syosi.price) AS goods_total_price, CASE WHEN syos.is_collected_shipping_cost = 1 THEN COALESCE(syos.shipping_cost, 0) ELSE 0 END AS shipping_fee, COALESCE(syos.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_fee FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item AS syosi LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub AS syos ON syosi.order_sub_id = syos.id AND syos.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order AS syo ON syos.order_id = syo.id AND syo.is_deleted = 0 WHERE syosi.is_deleted = 0 AND syo.customer_id = #{customerId} AND syo.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{customerLevelMonthRangeA} MONTH) GROUP BY syos.id, syos.order_id, syos.is_collected_shipping_cost, syos.shipping_cost, syos.discount_amount ) AS t

select syosi.*,pyp.code as productCode from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = syosi.product_id where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and syosi.specification_id is not null and order_sub_id = #{orderSubId}
SELECT min(a.`status`) FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item as a left join sal_yt_order_sub as b on a.order_sub_id=b.id where b.order_id=#{orderId} and a.is_deleted=0

select syosi.*,pyp.code as productCode from sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = syosi.product_id where syosi.is_deleted = 0 and order_sub_id in
#{orderSubId}

select * from sal_yt_order as syo left join sal_yt_order_sub as syso on syso.order_id = syo.id where syso.is_deleted=0 and syo.is_deleted=0 and syso.id = (select order_sub_id from sal_yt_order_sub_item where id = #{id})

select sum(b.enter_number) from sto_yt_delivery_item a left join sal_yt_order_sub_item b on a.order_sub_item_id =b.id where a.delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and b.specification_id=#{specificationId} and a.is_deleted=0 group by a.delivery_id
